#### List:

- Intro
- Benefits
- Harm
- Clinical use

#### Intro:

+-----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Definition      | - Positive end-expiratory pressure                                      |
+-----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Overall purpose | - Counteract the fall in FRC that occurs with anaesthesia               |
|                 | - Prevent collapse of small airways and alveoli                         |
|                 |   - Especially dependent regions                                        |
|                 |   - Especially at extubation                                            |
|                 |   - Note recruitment manoeuvres are required to re-open collapsed areas |
+-----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Typical range   | - 5-15cmH~2~O                                                           |
+-----------------+-------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Benefits of PEEP:

+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ↑Oxygenation                   | - ↑Lung volume → ↑Alveolar surface area → ↑gas exchange                                                                                                        |
|                                | - Prevent collapse → ↓shunt→↑PaO~2~ → ↑DO~2~                                                                                                                   |
|                                | - Note theoretical ‘sweet spot’ for DO~2~                                                                                                                      |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2016/A/11/prize-image001.jpg){fig-alt="Oxygen delivery, arterial oxygen pressure and cardiac output against increasing PEEP"}         |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                | (might not be so simple - see Nunn’s Applied Respiratory Physiology, Fig 30.3)                                                                                 |
+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ↑Lung compliance               | - ↑Static compliance: due to ↑lung volume → ↑alveolar radius                                                                                                   |
|                                | - ↑Dynamic compliance: due to prevention of small airway and alveolar collapse                                                                                 |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                |     →↓Airway pressure, ↓damage                                                                                                                                 |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2016/A/11/prize-image002.jpg){fig-alt="Lung volume and compliance curve showing insufficient, optimal and excessive PEEP"}            |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                | (modified from West’s Respiratory Physiology)                                                                                                                  |
+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ↓Airway resistance             | - Laminar flow: R = (8 x length x viscosity) / (π x radius^4^)                                                                                                 |
|                                | - Turbulent flow: (P~1~-P~2~) ∝ (length x density) / (radius^5^)                                                                                               |
|                                | - PEEP → ↑Lung volume → ↑airway radius → ↓resistance                                                                                                           |
|                                | - Radius is the major factor, since power 4 or 5                                                                                                               |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                |     →↓Airway pressure, ↓damage                                                                                                                                 |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2016/A/11/prize-image003.jpg){fig-alt="Airway resistance against lung volume"}                                                        |
+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ↓Pulmonary vascular resistance | - Low volume: compress extra-alveolar vessels                                                                                                                  |
|                                | - High volume: compress alveolar vessels                                                                                                                       |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                |     → PVR minimized at natural FRC                                                                                                                             |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2016/A/11/prize-image004.jpg){fig-alt="Pulmonary vascular resistance and alveolar and extra-alveolar components against lung volume"} |
+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Prevent damage                 | - ↓Alveolar collapse, ↓atelectrauma                                                                                                                            |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                |     → ↓Shear stress                                                                                                                                            |
|                                |                                                                                                                                                                |
|                                |     → ↓Inflammation                                                                                                                                            |
+--------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Harm from PEEP:

+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Alveolar damage       | - Over-PEEP → barotrauma, volutrauma, pneumothorax, pneumomediastinum |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Breath stacking       | - ↓Expiration rate → stacking → trauma                                |
|                       | - Higher risk if asthma, COPD                                         |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Dead space            | - ↑Alveolar pressure → ↑West zone 1                                   |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Impede cardiac output | - ↑Intrathoracic pressure → obstruction to venous return              |
|                       | - Higher risk if hypovolaemia                                         |
+-----------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+

#### Clinical use:

+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| General anaesthesia                   | - Prevent ↓FRC, with all the above benefits                                                                                                          |
+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Acute cardiogenic pulmonary oedema    | - Obstruction of venous return → normalization of preload                                                                                            |
|                                       | - ↓Transmural pressure- \> ↓afterload                                                                                                                |
| (as CPAP)                             | - Move alveolar water into interstitium                                                                                                              |
|                                       | - Increases lymphatic drainage                                                                                                                       |
|                                       | - (No effect on total lung water)                                                                                                                    |
|                                       |                                                                                                                                                      |
|                                       | ![](/content/exams/anzca/2016/A/11/prize-image005.jpg){fig-alt="Healthy and failing ventricular contraction against end-diastolic sarcomere length"} |
+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Type 2 respiratory failure (as BiPAP) | - Splints airways during expiration → shift equal pressure point proximally → ↓airway collapse → ↓obstruction                                        |
+---------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
